generationInputs.prompt: A stylized heart shape, outlined in a thick, dark green line, contains an aesthetically organized collection of botanical elements and food items. On the left side, four colorful leaf shapes – a green leaf angled top left to bottom right, a yellow leaf pointing up and left, a blue leaf pointing down and left, and a horizontal red leaf pointing right – are arranged around a thin, light green stem extending downwards from the blue leaf. The right side of the heart features a visually harmonious arrangement of a red apple, a yellow banana, a green avocado, stalks of golden wheat, and a cluster of purple grapes. The flat, graphic style uses solid colors without shading or texture, set against a plain white background, creating a cohesive and organized presentation of the food items.
